description: Operations documentation for ZO-SENTINEL. Must include: (1) supervisord configuration locations and how to reload; (2) log file paths for each daemon (per daemon name pattern /var/log/sentinel/{daemon_name}.log); (3) recovery runbook for stale heartbeats: check service_health table, identify stale services, check PID file, kill -9 and restart via supervisorctl; (4) recovery runbook for write_service failures: exponential backoff behavior, when to restart write_service; (5) how to verify enrichment modules are scoring correctly using enrichment_harness.py; (6) how to check freshness SLAs in service_health meta.
